en.quote: We are not going to cut anything [on the internet].
en.head: Register of banned websites
en.body: On July 28, 2012, a law establishing a register of websites containing prohibited information was adopted; it took effect on November 1. Roskomnadzor gained a mechanism to restrict access after notice and an opportunity to remove the material. The law prompted protests against censorship.

osrc.t: ConsultantPlus, overview of Law No. 139-FZ entering into force

notes: “Cut anything” preserves the colloquial wording; the original is an informal verb meaning to trim/censor.
